Subject: Staggered evidence & handoff — sequencing MSA / DPA / Order form

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — product looked promising. Procurement asked me to send our evaluation plan and flag a few sequencing questions so we can align legal and purchasing windows. Attached: CardinalAI_EvalPlan_v2.xlsx and a draft order form (summary-level).

Top asks from our side:
- Confirmation on the estimated legal review window for MSA + DPA redlines (we typically budget 2–3 weeks)
- Any required evidence we should surface up-front (SOC2, pen-test, data residency attestations)
- Recommended order form sign cadence relative to DPA execution (we prefer Order form signed within 3 business days after legal sign)
- Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) style milestones so our PMs can lock resources

We are planning a pilot evaluation starting the week of Nov 24 and would like to be contract-signed before Dec 12 if reasonable. Can you propose a MAP with owners and realistic review windows?

Attachments (2): CardinalAI_EvalPlan_v2.xlsx (Excel), CardinalAI_OrderForm_Draft.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz

Subject: Re: Staggered evidence & handoff — sequencing MSA / DPA / Order form

Elena — thanks for the materials, very clear. Looping in Karthik (legal) and Naomi (CS/onboarding) to own their lanes; Laura will pick up billing/order form work.

Proposed MAP (high level) — draft for your intake team:
1) Evidence & intake (Cardinal AI) — SOC2 + pen test link requested by 11/12 (owner: Elena)
2) Legal redline & DPA exceptions (Redwood legal) — Karthik 2 business weeks from receipt of full redline (target: complete by 11/24 if received by 11/10)
3) Order form finalization & commercial signoff (Redwood/Procurement) — standard 3 business days after legal sign; Laura to own invoice/MRN fields
4) Pilot activation (Onboarding) — Naomi to schedule environment and run acceptance tests; target start 11/24, cutover window 11/24–11/28
5) Final execution (DocuSign + PO) — after order form sign, procurement issues PO; target contract-signed by 12/12

Immediate asks for alignment:
- Karthik: can you confirm the DPA baseline and whether data residency carveouts are needed?
- Naomi: can you confirm acceptance test checklist items you need from Cardinal AI (sample prompts, dataset size, SLA expectations)?
- Elena / Procurement: confirm Net30/Net45 and invoice milestone preference so Laura can wire the order form fields correctly.

I attached a one-page MAP I put together to make this concrete (CardinalAI_MAP_Sofia_v1.xlsx). If the high-level milestones look sane I can push a calendar with milestone owners and a DocuSign envelope skeleton.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova

Subject: Re: Staggered evidence & handoff — sequencing MSA / DPA / Order form

Sofia / Elena — quick legal read.

Summary: Redwood can commit to a standard DPA but will need to review the CardinalAI redlines. Two items I expect to flag up-front:
- Data residency clause: if Cardinal requires EU-only processing we will need to confirm deployment region and KMS controls (likely an addendum).
- Export controls / restricted data: request clarification on any PHI/PII flows (DPA handles this but may require a scoping doc).

Timing: assuming we receive a clean set of redlines and SOC2 evidence by 11/12, legal can turn in ~10 business days (target 11/24). If there are material DPA exceptions or a region addendum that will extend the timeline; we should surface those immediately.

Commercial / procurement ask: what payment terms does Cardinal require (Net30 / Net45 / PO lead time)? That will affect Laura's order form cadence.

Naomi: for acceptance testing I will need the pass/fail criteria echoed in the MAP so any data handling constraints are explicit.

Quoted for context:
> Sofia proposed MAP with owners and milestones (see earlier in thread).

I'll draft the initial DPA response and share a tracked version by EOD tomorrow.

— Karthik Iyer
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cardinalai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2025-11-12T15:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Staggered evidence & handoff — sequencing MSA / DPA / Order form

Karthik / Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround and clarity. A few clarifications from procurement:
- Cardinal confirms Net30 and will issue PO immediately following order form signature; invoice milestone should be aligned to the PO effective date.
- We intend to run a two-week pilot (canary) — would you be comfortable with a pilot clause that limits production data or tokens for the pilot window? We can document acceptance criteria.
- SOC2 link: https://evidence.cardinalai.com/soc2-report (attached with initial intake).

Next steps: please send the tracked DPA by EOD tomorrow and Laura, if you can pre-populate the order form with Net30 and the PO fields we will circulate internally. Once the order form and DPA are in sync we will send a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — will await your DPA draft.
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement | Cardinal AI
